in_sanskrit.name: कृष्णानन्द
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Kreeshansh is derived from Sanskrit words 'कृष्ण' (Krishna) and 'आनन्द' (Anand), which mean 'God' and 'grace, pleasure, bliss' respectively. Thus, Kreeshansh can be translated to mean 'God Krishna's grace'.

in_hindi.name: कृष्णानंद
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Kreeshansh in Hindi is derived from the words 'कृष्ण' (Krishna) and 'अनन्द' (Anand). 'कृष्ण' refers to the Hindu god Krishna, while 'अनन्द' means 'grace, pleasure, bliss'. Therefore, Kreeshansh can be translated to mean 'God Krishna's grace' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: கிருஷ்ணானந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Kreeshansh is written as கிருஷ்ணானந்த. The first part, 'கிருஷ்ணா' (Kirushna), refers to Lord Krishna, while 'அனந்தம்' (Anandam) means 'grace, pleasure, bliss'. Thus, the name Kreeshansh can be translated to mean 'God Krishna's grace' in Tamil.
